text:
zoe: quick design review  axis tick localization + dense-series focus mode. Problem: dashboards with international teams show '1.2M' vs '1,2M' and tick separators mislead non-US readers. proposal: localized tick formatting + tooltip with full text (e.g., '1.2 million' or '1,2 Millionen'). also a dense-mode focus that hides minor series and increases tick density. thoughts? :globe_with_meridians:

patrick: really like localized ticks. how would we surface unit context? the axis title alone isn't always enough on shared reports. maybe the unit pill can include locale-aware text on hover like "Units: 1,000 = one thousand"

mira: +1 for hover expansion. accessibility nit: screenreader should announce both localized value and the canonical value (e.g., "1,2 Millionen (1.2M)") so listeners understand magnitude independent of locale.

zoe: prototype idea: unit pill shows local short ("M") but aria-label reads expanded canonical + localized phrase. Also added a dense focus toggle in legend menu to temporarily hide low-impact series. config sketch in proto (just for context):
```
axisTicks: { locale: "auto", showSeparators: true, expandOnHover: true },
unitPill: { display: "short", ariaLabel: "Units: millions (canonical: 1.2M)" },
legend: { denseFocusToggle: true }
```

patrick: dense-focus toggle UX: maybe a quick 'focus X' action on series right-click to hide others and bump tick granularity. keyboard users need an equivalent: press 'f' when a series is focused in legend to focus it.

mira: a11y for dense-focus: when activated announce "Focused on series: API errors. Other series hidden." Provide a visible affordance to exit focus. For outliers in focus mode, still show flagged markers and ensure they are keyboard focusable (12px target) and have non-color indicators (icon + patterned stroke).

zoe: copy microcopy for tick tooltip: prefer concise: "1,2M (1.2 million)" rather than full sentence. for unit pill hover: "Units: requests (1 = one request)" or localized equivalent.

patrick: export note: PDF/PNG exports should embed an 'export metadata' block with canonical values and locale used, e.g., "export_meta: {locale: en-GB, canonical_format: 1.2M}" so recipients offline can interpret numbers.

mira: testing: add acceptance tests: 1) VoiceOver reads localized + canonical values; 2) dense-focus keyboard shortcut works and announces appropriately; 3) outlier markers accessible and non-color reliant; 4) exported metadata present.

coachbot: created ticket #6112: "axis tick localization + dense-focus mode + export metadata" assigned to @zoe and @mira.

zoe: thanks team  i'll prototype locale-aware tick formatting and dense-focus interactions, include both pill copy variants for A/B, and post updated Figma later today. closing thread after prototype upload. :sparkles:
